The '''Fairy Griffin Skin''' is an {{Mythic}} [[Pet Skin]] that could be purchased from the Hypixel Store.

== Obtaining ==
{{Cosmetic Miscellaneous Source|The '''Fairy Griffin Skin''' could be purchased from the Hypixel Store during a 2026 Hypixel Store Halloween promotion.|2026 Hypixel Store Halloween Promotion}}
